summary.en: A grease-pencil loop is drawn by hand round one cell of a contact sheet while the other rows step back; or an underline under the address.
summary.zh: 用蜡笔手绘一圈圈住印样上的一格，其他行退后；或在网址下画一道线。

fits: A choice made by a person: the pick among many, the address to remember.
notFor: Marking several things; anything on a dark frame.

intent.en: A hand mark that reads as a choice, not as the system’s highlight.
intent.zh: 一道手迹，读起来是人的选择，而不是系统的高亮。

content.en: The cell to loop (row, cell) or the address to underline.
content.zh: 要圈的格（行、格）或要画线的网址。

fits.zh: 人做的选择：从许多里挑一个，要记住的网址。

notFor.zh: 同时标多处；画在深色画格上。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
